title: Denied tools: dedupe the list, bound the line, fix stale slicer-rule docs
lead: From the S23 relay. (1) The denials list is not deduplicated, so 'Write, Write' can appear, and the status line is unbounded. (2) A denied slicer step in a successful round no longer stops mechanically (#93); docs/design.md:289 and docs/glossary.md:113-114 still state slicer's rule, and ork relies on internal/roles/prompts/implementer.md:72-73. Correction from the S29 run (2026-10-20): the vendor does report the denied command (permission_denials[].tool_input, testdata/vendors/claude/04-allowlist-denies-write.stdout); ork keeps only the tool name, so recording the command is a separate slice.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
From the S23 relay. (1) The denials list is not deduplicated, so 'Write, Write' can appear, and the status line is unbounded. (2) A denied slicer step in a successful round no longer stops mechanically (#93), but docs/design.md:316 and docs/glossary.md:113-114 still state slicer's rule, and ork relies on internal/roles/prompts/implementer.md:72-73.

Update 2026-10-20: ork now records the denied command (S45: internal/agent/claude/types.go:73, internal/runrec/record.go:71), so the old "record the command" part of this item is done.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/daemon/runs.go`: engineRuns denials (:454-457) and roleDenials (:463-474). Tests: `internal/daemon/engine_runs_test.go` (:39).
- `internal/source/source.go`: new helper next to EngineRun (:153-163). Tests: `internal/source/source_test.go`.
- `internal/cli/daemoncmds.go:48-56`: denial text at :53-54. Tests: `internal/cli/cli_test.go`.
- `internal/tui/overview.go:98-108`: denial text at :105-106. Tests: `internal/tui/golden_test.go`; `testdata/golden/engine-denials-100x30.txt` only if it changes.
- `docs/design.md:316` (contract bullet; the old reference :289 is a different line now). `docs/glossary.md:113-114`.
- `internal/roles/prompts/implementer.md:72-73` (match decision 93).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- Denied tool names appear once each, with a count, and the status line is bounded with a 'more' marker.
- design.md and glossary.md describe the decided policy (#93).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests first. In internal/daemon/engine_runs_test.go, extend TestEngineSnapshotAndStatusShowEachDenialsCommand (:39) with two roles and a repeated denial. Each text must appear once, with a count (format: "Write: /x.txt x2"). Add a test in internal/source for the new bounding helper (*proposed* name source.DenialsText): five distinct denials show three and "and 2 more" (the bound is 3).
2. In internal/daemon/runs.go:454-457, engineRuns builds Denials per role through roleDenials (:463-474). Dedupe across all roles, keep first-seen order, and add the count when a text repeats.
3. Add the helper in internal/source/source.go next to EngineRun (:153-163). Use it in internal/cli/daemoncmds.go:53-54 and internal/tui/overview.go:105-106 in place of strings.Join.
4. Do not change how commands are recorded. DeniedCommand already holds the command (internal/runrec/record.go:73-76; internal/daemon/runner.go:41).
5. docs/design.md:316 is the contract bullet "a permission denial on a slicer step". Rewrite the ork rule to decision 93 (engine.denials): a denial stops only an unsuccessful round, as design.md:283-284 already says. Make the same change at docs/glossary.md:113-114.
6. internal/roles/prompts/implementer.md:72-73: make the prompt match decision 93 (a denial stops only an unsuccessful round).
7. If the overview golden changes, run `go test ./internal/tui -update` and review testdata/golden/engine-denials-100x30.txt (it shows "denied: Write, Bash" at lines 7 and 27).
Decided: bound 3 with 'and N more'; repeat count 'x2'; keep the design.md:316 bullet and add a note that ork follows decision 93 (do not paste the contract text, AGENTS.md); update implementer.md:72-73 to match 93.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:

- `go vet ./...`

- `rg -n "permission denial on a slicer step|slicer step is denied" docs internal/roles/prompts`: only the bullet kept with its decision-93 note should remain.
